versionHistory.justification: Incorporate feedback from technical review FB-001: added CDN verification step, unit tests, accessibility, error UX, version pinning, primitive schema UX, rendering timeout, reversibility scope clarification.
versionHistory.diffSummary: Added step-cdn-verify (XS) and step-unit-tests (S); enhanced step-hook with error UX, timeout, version pinning; enhanced step-component with a11y and primitive schema UX; expanded step-e2e with dark mode and error tests; added 2 acceptance criteria (a11y, version pinning); added 2 intent constraints; added decision dec-reversibility-scope; updated 3 risks.

problem.problemStatement: The Zod playground has no visual representation of schema structure. Users write Zod schemas and test values but cannot see ER diagrams, class diagrams, or flowcharts of their schema relationships, making it harder to understand complex nested schemas at a glance.
problem.successOutcome: Users can click a Diagram tab in the right panel to see a Mermaid-rendered ER diagram (default), class diagram, or flowchart of their Zod 4 schema, with diagram type switching, dark mode support, and copy-to-clipboard for the Mermaid markup.
problem.costOfInaction: Users continue relying on mental parsing of schema code to understand structure; the playground misses an opportunity to differentiate through visual tooling.

steps.title: Create useSchemaVisualization hook
steps.description: Implement the core async hook that lazy-loads zod-mermaid and mermaid from CDN using pinned versions from cdn.ts (cached after first load), debounces diagram generation (500ms), prevents stale renders via generation counter, and respects dark mode by re-initializing mermaid with theme:'dark' based on Mantine color scheme. Returns { svg, mermaidText, isLoading, error }. Error handling: CDN fetch timeout at 10s — on failure, return error 'Diagram unavailable — could not load visualization libraries.' Mermaid rendering timeout at 5s — on timeout, return error 'Diagram generation timed out for this schema.' All errors surfaced through the error return value for the component to render as Mantine Alert.

risks.description: jsDelivr +esm transform may fail for zod-mermaid due to deep imports or CommonJS internals that don't transpile cleanly to ESM
risks.mitigation: step-cdn-verify validates CDN URL resolution before implementation. Pinned versions in cdn.ts prevent silent breakage from upstream releases. Verify import resolves in browser devtools.
risks.fallback: Fall back to esm.sh CDN or bundle zod-mermaid as a last resort

risks.description: Cross-Zod-version duck typing may break if zod-mermaid uses instanceof checks instead of property-based checks against CDN-loaded Zod schemas
risks.mitigation: step-cdn-verify examines zod-mermaid source to confirm property-based introspection (.def.type). If instanceof checks are found, halt and escalate per stop condition.

risks.description: Mermaid dark mode rendering may produce illegible diagrams if theme initialization doesn't propagate correctly
risks.mitigation: Pass theme:'dark' to mermaid.initialize() based on Mantine useComputedColorScheme; re-render on scheme change. E2E tests include dark mode rendering verification.

risks.description: Large schemas may produce unreadable diagrams that overflow the visible area, or mermaid.render() may hang on complex input
risks.mitigation: SVG container with overflow:auto scroll. Mermaid rendering timeout at 5s — abort and show error if exceeded. Future enhancement: add zoom/pan controls.

risks.description: Primitive schemas (e.g. z.string()) produce trivial or empty diagrams that may confuse users
risks.mitigation: For non-object schemas, display Mantine Alert (variant='light', color='blue'): 'Schema visualization works best with object schemas. Your current schema is a [type] type.' Diagram tab remains enabled — rendering still attempted since arrays of objects may produce useful diagrams.

decisions.title: Load zod-mermaid and mermaid from CDN at runtime with pinned versions
decisions.chosen: CDN dynamic import via jsDelivr — both zod-mermaid and mermaid loaded at runtime with pinned semver versions (determined by step-cdn-verify), not bundled. This avoids cross-instance Zod instanceof failures and keeps the app bundle unchanged (~2MB mermaid stays out of bundle). Version pinning prevents silent breakage from upstream CDN releases.

alternatives.option: Bundle zod-mermaid and mermaid as npm dependencies
alternatives.rejectionReason: zod-mermaid imports zod internally — bundled copy gets its own Zod instance, causing instanceof check failures against CDN-loaded schemas. Also adds ~2MB to bundle.

alternatives.option: Bundle zod-mermaid only, load mermaid from CDN
alternatives.rejectionReason: Still has the cross-instance Zod problem for zod-mermaid's internal zod import.
App can break without code changes when upstream releases incompatible versions. Violates reproducibility principle.

decisions.title: Use Tabs in right panel instead of third panel
decisions.chosen: Mantine Tabs component in the right panel toggles between Values and Diagram views. Minimal layout change; two-panel structure preserved.

alternatives.rejectionReason: Would crowd screens — each panel gets ~440px on 1440px. Users rarely need values and diagram simultaneously.
Breaks the side-by-side editing workflow. Diagram should feel integrated, not secondary.

decisions.title: Reversibility claims apply to code-level changes only
decisions.chosen: All plan steps are code-level reversible via git operations (git rm for created files, git checkout for modified files). Post-deployment feature removal — shared playground URLs referencing diagram state, user expectations, reputational considerations — requires separate release management not covered by this implementation plan. Feature flags and gradual rollout are not planned.

alternatives.option: Add feature flags for gradual rollout
alternatives.rejectionReason: Over-engineering for a playground app with no persistent state or user accounts. The feature can be cleanly removed via code revert at the implementation level.
